# UE auth caller boundary — primary agent review

Reviewer: Codex /root. This is a primary-agent source review, not a separate-agent or human security-team approval. Account usage limits prevented a new independent agent review. Historical separate-agent reports cover their original PR984 scopes only.

Scope: PR986, branch fix/ue-auth-storage-callers-20261022, base 441556737ffe0e36c6ec9bf6bd9c24bab5302559. Initial application source 17043ac13742a8ebadc8e679afe047580d2dea00. The final signed manifest separately binds every reviewed source and base blob, including these governance amendments.

The isolated clone demonstrated real SQL42501 denials for legacy raw-auth callers after the canonical boundary was installed. Those denials are correct and are preserved. Deadline lookup now requires an active, nondeleted business membership in the grievance organization before opening a canonical email-selected auth lookup. It additionally constrains the assigned user ID and active/unlocked account. Missing membership never opens auth authority; auth gateway failure propagates rather than producing a successful contact resolution.

Member administrator routes retain their existing platform-administrator guards. Auth mutations also bind the real authenticated actor, target user, organization, operation and reason. Session revocation uses the native scoped auth client; raw systemDb overrides are removed. Independent revocation steps still maximize denial coverage and report partial failure. Reactivation uses one physical auth-system transaction spanning auth and business schemas, with both RETURNING row counts required. A missing second row cannot leave the first authority write committed.

The companion SQL grants the nonlogin auth system executor SELECT on id/user/organization/status and UPDATE on status/updated_at only. It requires forced RLS, separate ownership, a safe canonical role, no inherited business-role auth authority, and no unexplained prior projection grants or policies. New policies constrain the exact target and organization, system membership-state operation, actor and reason. Updates require active status. Private contacts, ownership retargeting, deletion and arbitrary status changes remain denied. The broad canonical platform authorization migration is not applied or stamped.

Evidence: 15 PGlite policy tests and 32 focused caller/scheduler tests pass. Fourteen actual Azure PostgreSQL15 rollback checks pass using verified TLS and the dedicated non-BYPASS migration principal. The canonical auth bootstrap SHA256 remains 6d306bec3905bf50ddf141410c0b2ae263979877dc094f79519f1b69954f3834. The clone-only projection was then installed and tested through the actual dedicated NOINHERIT auth-system LOGIN and native executeAuthContext. Both writes used the same backend connection; deliberate transaction aborts after successful writes and after a missing second row restored exact full-row fingerprints in both existing membership tables. These are source/gateway clone proofs, not deployed image or browser acceptance.

The delegated gate amendment is limited to exact PR986/base/branch/actual connector author anungisa, alongside the historical PR984 binding. The owner remains anungis437 and the operator Codex; no owner impersonation or security label is synthesized. The pinned public key must remain identical to the immutable merged base. The two metadata allowlist additions are exact file paths; canonical auth SQL and execution-boundary files are not newly allowed. All source changes and the gate itself must be included in a genuine owner-controlled delegated Ed25519 signature. The unchanged expiry, resources, instruction hash, production=false, runtime-proof and signed-release requirements remain mandatory. Seventy-one verifier tests pass, including unlisted PRs, mismatched bindings, false primary attribution, changed key blobs/bytes and adjacent path denials.

No unresolved P0/P1 findings were identified within this reviewed change. Other legacy auth callers remain explicitly recorded in the authority declarations and have not been claimed repaired. Root validation and exact final-head protected Linux CI remain mandatory; failed Windows aggregate results must be recorded as failed. The clone projection is not applied to live staging by this review. Final integrated images, signed clone/release qualification, governed live migration, real Entra and worker acceptance, and controlled staging cutover remain outstanding. Staging remains NO_GO; production authorization remains NO.

The earlier draft PR985 used the app-default codex/ prefix, which the existing repository branch policy rejects. PR985 was preserved and closed as superseded by PR986; no branch naming rule was modified. The replacement fix/ branch passed the actual branch-policy CLI. Only the exact PR/branch binding and a superseded-PR rejection test changed after the retained full lint/typecheck/docs/governance run; all application and database execution source files are unchanged. The amended verifier passes71 tests; exact replacement-head protected CI is mandatory. The full local fast-test run continues, and an unfinished aggregate is not represented as PASS.
